name: Docker tools (host daemon)
description: Pinned Docker CLI, Compose v2 and Buildx wired to the HOST Docker daemon (Docker-outside-of-Docker): the feature declares the /var/run/docker.sock bind itself, so projects opt in with one feature line and no per-project runArgs. Requires a reachable host docker socket at container create time; builds run on the host engine and share its image/layer cache. The forwarded socket is host-root-equivalent — add this feature only to projects that need it.

docker.description: Docker static client version (versioned tarball from download.docker.com; no upstream checksum — pin updates are manual, like gcloud). 'none' skips.

compose.description: Docker Compose v2 plugin version (GitHub release, installed into cli-plugins). 'none' skips.

buildx.description: Buildx plugin version (GitHub release, installed into cli-plugins). 'none' skips.

socket_path.description: Container path where the entrypoint expects the bound host socket. Keep the default: feature options cannot move this feature's manifest bind (fixed target /var/run/docker-host.sock). For non-default hosts (rootless Docker, Podman) add a devcontainer.json mount with the SAME target and your own source — the CLI dedupes mounts by target, devcontainer.json wins the source.
